title: Improving 911 Reliability: Facilitating Implementation of Next Generation 911 Services
pass_4_primary_concern: The proposal is directionally coherent, but the DVC and interoperability tracks still need clearer deployment data, verification design, and burden analysis before finalization.
pass_5_high_stakes_domain_reason: The proposal concerns 911 reliability and accessibility, including emergency-call routing and ASL-based access, so failures can affect emergency access for callers.
pass_5_concise_why: The proposal is coherent but still needs a clearer deployment and verification record for DVC-to-911 and the proposed interoperability regime.
pass_5_most_important_consequence: If the FCC finalizes the framework before routing, staffing, and verification details are pinned down, states and providers could build around a regime that is hard to execute consistently across jurisdictions.
